settings.title: FAQ settings
settings.subtitle: Switch FAQ answering on and tune how closely a message has to match.
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings. Changing them needs the permission faq.settings.manage, usually held by workspace admins.
settings.engineOff: FAQ answering is switched off by the platform. Whatever you set here applies once it is back on.
settings.conflict: Someone else saved these settings. Reload to see their version, then make your change again.

modelChanged.title: Review your sensitivity
modelChanged.body: The platform changed the AI model after you tuned this threshold. Scores moved, so review your sensitivity. Saving confirms it.

enable.title: FAQ answering
enable.label: Answer customers with FAQs
enable.onBody: When a customer writes in, the bot compares the message with your FAQs and replies with the best answer, or starts its flow. A flow or keyword trigger that already took the message wins.
enable.offBody: Customers get no FAQ answers. You can still write and test FAQs.

sens.title: Sensitivity
sens.hint: How closely a message must match. Scores belong to the model {model}.
sens.label: Answer when the match is at least
sens.explain: At {value}%, a message is answered only when its best match scores {value}% or more. Higher means fewer but safer answers; lower means more answers and a higher chance of a wrong one.
sens.modelScale: Scores are only comparable within one model. If the platform changes the model ({model}), review this number.

margin.title: Ambiguity guard
margin.hint: Stops the bot guessing between two FAQs that score almost the same.
margin.label: Minimum lead over the second best
margin.explain: When the best FAQ leads the runner-up by less than this, the bot stays quiet and logs the message as unanswered. Leave it off if your FAQs rarely overlap.

log.title: Customer messages in the log
log.label: Keep customer messages in the match log
log.onBody: The text of each message is kept for 90 days so you can see why it was or was not answered and learn from it. After that it is deleted.
log.offBody: Only scores and outcomes are kept, never the text. You can still see how often the bot answers, but you cannot learn from unanswered messages.

how.title: How matching works
how.exact: Exact: the message equals a saved phrasing, ignoring case and spacing.
how.semantic: Meaning: the message is compared by meaning with every live phrasing, so different words can match.
how.trigram: Spelling fallback: if the AI provider is unavailable, letters are compared instead, which catches typos only.
how.threshold: The best score is compared with the sensitivity. Above it, the FAQ answers; below it, the message is listed under Unanswered.
how.verify: Second check (optional): a match that only just reached the sensitivity can be double-checked by a small chat model, which can only withhold an answer.

settings.who: Changing these settings needs the permission faq.settings.manage.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: Your changes to these settings are not saved.

verify.title: Second check for close calls
verify.hint: A small chat model double-checks matches that only just reached the bar.
verify.unavailable: The platform has switched the second check off, so it does not run even if you turn it on here. Ask your platform admin.
verify.label: Check close calls with a second opinion
verify.onBody: When a match only just clears the bar, a small chat model reads the customer's message and the FAQ and says whether the answer fits. It can only say no: it never makes an answer happen.
verify.offBody: Every match that reaches the bar is answered without a second look.
verify.bandLabel: How close counts as a close call
verify.explainOn: Matches scoring from {from}% up to {to}% are checked by {model}. A "no" means no answer is sent and the message appears under Unanswered.
verify.explainOff: Every match scoring {threshold}% or more is answered. Turn the second check on to have the closest calls double-checked.
verify.cost: Each check sends the customer's message and the FAQ's question to the model: a few hundred tokens, and it adds about a second to a borderline reply. Matches outside the band are never checked. If the check fails, is not available or the hourly limit is reached, the match stands as if there were no check.

flowNode.label: Start at
flowNode.hint: Choose a step to skip the beginning of the flow. Customers enter the flow at the step you pick.
flowNode.loading: Loading the steps of this flow
flowNode.empty: This flow has no other steps, so it starts at its beginning.

missing.title: The step this FAQ starts at is gone
missing.body: That step was deleted from the flow. Until you choose another step, customers who match this FAQ get no answer. Pick a step below, or start at the flow's start.

body.confirmed: The match was a close call, so a small chat model read the message and the FAQ and agreed the answer fits.
body.vetoed: The match was a close call and the second check said this FAQ does not answer the message. The answer was withheld, nothing was sent, and the message appears under Unanswered.
body.failed: The match was a close call, but the check could not finish, so the match stood and the answer was sent as if there were no second check.
body.skipped: The second check did not run for this match, so the match stood as it was.
